svg.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero: pins used by this sensor
all connections are on ONE long edge: 5V, GND, 3V3, GP1, GP2, GP4, GP5, GP6 (GP3 stays free)
USB-C up, chip and buttons facing you
USB-C up, the side that lies on the rails in the housing
GPIO21 drives the on-board RGB LED, nothing to wire. GP14/15/16 are small pads on the top side, GP17/18/38-45 pads on the bottom: not used.
Never have USB-C plugged in while the 5V pin is fed from the S09 (12 V on): the 5V pin is the USB VBUS line.
